summary: Expanded the AI networking/optical-interconnect universe beyond seed names toward suppliers tied to potential chokepoints: optical DSPs, 800G/1.6T optics, InP/EML lasers, active electrical cables, high-speed connectors, and fiber-optic interconnect systems. The highest-relevance additions are Marvell for AI interconnect silicon and DSPs; Coherent and Lumentum for lasers/optical components; Credo for AEC/DSP connectivity inside AI racks; and Amphenol for high-speed copper/fiber interconnect infrastructure. This is a research universe expansion only, not a recommendation.
